meta.prompt: The graph of a function \(f(x)\) is given below. Sort the intervals on the left according to whether the graph of \(f(x)\) satisfies the properties on the right. If some intervals are unused, be sure you can explain why. Graph of a polynomial function in the first quadrant. \begin{tikzpicture} \begin{axis}[ xmin=-8.5, xmax=6.5, ymin=-10.9, ymax=6.5, grid=both, xtick={-7,-5,-3,-1,1,3,5}, minor xtick={-8,-6,-4,-2,2,4,6}, ytick={-10,-6,-2,2,6}, minor ytick={-8,-4,4} ] \addplot+[domain=-8:6,samples=100] {0.002*(x+2)*(x-3)*(x+4)*(x-0.5)*(x-5)*(x+7)}; \end{axis} \end{tikzpicture}
